props.name: children
props.comment:
The child input rendered against the reference choices context. Defaults to
`<AutocompleteInput>`.

props.name: debounceMs
props.comment: Debounce delay (ms) for filter-driven choices refetches.

props.name: filter
props.comment: Permanent filter merged OVER the dynamic filter for every choices fetch.

props.name: lookupKey
props.comment:
The field on the referenced record the value matches. `"id"` (default)
resolves the selected record via `getMany`; any other key resolves it via
`getList({ filter: { [lookupKey]: value } })`.

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource choices are fetched from (e.g. `"companies"`). A registered resource name.

props.name: sort
props.comment: Sort applied to the choices query.

props.name: source
props.comment: The FK field on the current record (e.g. `"company_id"`).

props.name: validate
props.comment:
`<ReferenceInput>` does not accept a validate prop — set `validate` on the
child input instead (the child owns the form binding).
